Chilliwack's ground-oriented 55+ stock is scattered: the named homes below sit on Young Road south of Highway 1, Patten Avenue in Chilliwack Proper, and Chehalis Drive in Sardis. Sardis is a Chilliwack neighbourhood south of Highway 1, bordered by the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) west and east.

Cottage Grove, 8500 Young Road, is the clearest buyable ground-oriented 55+ product: a gated bare-land strata of detached one-level ranchers, each on its own strata lot. Confirm the registered age bylaw on the Form B before relying on it.

Chartwell Birchwood, 45650 Patten Avenue, offers seniors' townhouses beside its retirement residence — two bedrooms, full kitchen, in-suite laundry, balcony and patio, in four floor plans. It is rental retirement living, not a strata you can buy.

Elim Village, 45412 Chehalis Drive in Garrison Crossing, Sardis, is a seniors village including The Redwood, a four-storey independent-living building of 64 suites. Elim's own pages describe rental and life-lease style housing, not freehold townhome strata.

blocks.text: Chilliwack 55+ Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A 55+ bylaw is now the only age restriction a British Columbia strata may have: effective November 24, 2022, a strata may only restrict age at not less than 55 years, with exemptions for some caregivers and for residents who already lived in the lot.

From May 1, 2023, further exemptions cover children, including adult children, and younger spouses or partners of an exempt resident — the complex's registered bylaw still states how the rule is applied.
Rental-restriction bylaws are no longer enforceable in British Columbia stratas, but a valid 55+ bylaw still controls who may live in the unit, including a tenant.

blocks.text: Chilliwack 55+ Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Fraser Health's Chilliwack Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at #104 – 7955 Evans Road, co-located with the rural primary care centre — same-day care for non-life-threatening concerns, on the city's west side.

Curbside collection changed May 1, 2026: compostables weekly, garbage and recycling alternating bi-weekly, glass and flexible plastics monthly, Tuesday to Friday, carts out by 7:00 a.m. A strata may handle this internally — confirm before assuming.
Chartwell Birchwood states it sits next to Townsend Park, near the Landing Leisure Centre and Chilliwack General Hospital — the reason so much seniors housing clusters on Patten and Hodgins avenues.
City utility and solid-waste charges are billed quarterly, under the bylaws named on the City's rates page; a strata may carry some through strata fees.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies in the City of Chilliwack, a listed taxable area, so an empty 55+ townhome still needs the annual declaration.

BC Transit, not TransLink, runs Chilliwack transit. Route 51 Vedder links Downtown with the University of the Fraser Valley (UFV) Chilliwack campus via Vedder Road, the Sardis corridor nearest Elim Village.
Route 52 Evans runs Cottonwood Mall to Downtown via Evans Road, the corridor for the urgent and primary care centre in.

blocks.text: Chilliwack 55+ Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519 sets Flood Construction Levels (FCLs) in Chilliwack; the City guide states new construction generally needs the lowest habitable floor at FCL plus 0.6 metres freeboard. Check the parcel, not the neighbourhood.
The same bylaw sets a 75-metre building setback from the natural boundary of the Vedder River, relevant to south-side lots.

The Sardis-Vedder Aquifer is Development Permit Area 1 in the 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, Schedule D-1, so construction or a new well in the mapped area can require a development permit.

blocks.text: What is not confirmed about Chilliwack 55+ Townhomes

items.t: A conventional 55+ townhome strata (row or duplex strata townhomes with a registered 55+ bylaw) in Chilliwack: none confirmed from a municipal, strata or developer source. Cottage Grove is bare-land strata ranchers; Birchwood townhouses are rental; Elim Village is a seniors village.

Chilliwack Bylaw 3055 conflict is OPEN — the City's subdivisions webpage names a "Land Development Bylaw 2014, No. 3055" while the verified ledger holds it was never adopted; it is not stated as governing here.

faq.q: Can my 52-year-old spouse live with me in a 55+ townhome?
faq.a: Possibly, under the provincial exemptions. Since May 1, 2023, British Columbia law exempts younger spouses or partners, and children including adult children, of a qualifying resident from a 55+ age-restriction bylaw. The strata's registered bylaw is still the document to read before offering, because it states how this complex applies the rule.

faq.q: Is Cottage Grove a townhome, a house or a condo?
faq.a: It is a bare-land strata of detached ranchers at 8500 Young Road, which is why it appears on ground-oriented searches. You own a strata lot and a one-level detached home; the strata carries the common property and the gate. That differs from a freehold Young Road house and from an apartment condo, and the strata documents settle fees and responsibilities.

faq.q: Are the Chartwell Birchwood townhouses for sale?
faq.a: No. Chartwell presents its townhouses at 45650 Patten Avenue as seniors' townhouses inside a retirement residence, with weekly housekeeping and emergency response included, beside the main residence near Chilliwack General Hospital. They are rented as retirement living. A buyer who wants to own should look at strata product such as Cottage Grove, and treat Birchwood as the rental alternative in the same decision.

Chilliwack General Hospital, 45600 Menholm Road, is the city's Fraser Health community hospital, providing primary, core secondary and some specialty services. The Patten Avenue seniors cluster sits in its precinct; Cottage Grove and Elim Village are south of Highway 1 in Sardis, so their hospital trip crosses the highway interchange.
